Method of Attack: Steals sensitive information from a Windows-based host (e.g., passwords, credit cards, cookies and session data, and general keylogging)
Uses a decoy document to disguise its presence
Collects system information and screenshots using PowerShell and command-line tools
Exfiltrates collected data via Discord webhook
Attack Vector: Initial infection vector not explicitly known, but could include phishing, watering holes, or other malware
Decoy document (BNG 824 ruhsat.pdf) used to deceive users
